card.name: Linking words after foods, drugs, or 'use in'
card.fires_on: The small linking word (and, or, of, such, following) right after a general category noun like foods, drugs, medications or type, mostly in drug interaction and avoidance lists. It also fires on 'such' in 'use in such patients'.
